id: Recloose with Special Guests & Benny Salvador-San Fran, Wellington -Ticket Master
name: Recloose with Special Guests & Benny Salvador
long_description:
Music First & Aunty Records present…
RECLOOSE (USA)
 With special guests & Benny Salvador
 
 Saturday 19 December 2026 | San Fran, Wellington | 9pm–3am
 
 We’re thrilled to welcome the one and only Recloose back to Wellington this December!
 
A true original in electronic music, Recloose first made his mark on Detroit’s legendary Planet E label, carving out a distinctive sound that draws on house, disco, jazz, funk and soul.
 
Now based back in Philadelphia, following many years living in Aotearoa, Recloose returns with his unmistakable blend of deep, soulful and adventurous dance music.
 
 Joining him on the night is Wellington favourite Benny Salvador, alongside some very special guests still to be announced.
 
 A proper end-of-year session at San Fran, brought to you by Music First & Aunty Records.
 
 Tickets on sale Thursday 5 November at 10am NZDT.
 Early Bird $25 + BF (limited to 30) | General Admission $30 + BF | Final Release $35 + BF

id: Big Country (Scotland) Greatest Hits Tour-San Fran, Wellington -Ticket Master
name: Big Country (Scotland) Greatest Hits Tour
long_description:
Legendary 80’s Scottish rockers BIG COUNTRY bring their Greatest Hits Tour down under in June 2027 with Special Guest Evan Peters Presents The Alarm (Acoustic).

Big Country broke with their debut album The Crossing selling over 2 million copies worldwide (Certified Gold in NZ). 

The band is now fronted by fellow Scot Tommie Paxton, who looks and sounds uncannily like the late great Stuart Adamson and joins original member Bruce Watson. 

Setlist includes - “In a Big Country”, “Fields of Fire”, “Chance”, “Look Away”, “Wonderland” and more

Big Country’s sound and spirit remains and when “In a Big Country” erupts, every voice in the room joins in…. See them live. Thank us later.










San Fran holds a Supervised License. Minors are welcome to attend events at San Fran so long as they are accompanied by a legal guardian at all times whilst at the venue.

id: Fashion Thrift Society | Wellington November 27th-TSB Arena, Wellington -Ticket Master
name: Fashion Thrift Society | Wellington November 27th
long_description:
FASHION THRIFT SOCIETY – AUSTRALIA’S BIGGEST CURATED FASHION MARKET

FASHION THRIFT SOCIETY IS COMING TO WELLINGTON

Wellington, Fashion Thrift Society is taking over TSB Arena on Saturday 27th of November from 10AM–4PM.

Australia’s biggest curated fashion market brings together vintage, preloved and independent fashion, local creatives, food, music, beauty, experiences and more - all under one roof.

WHAT’S ON

75+ curated stalls featuring vintage, preloved, designer and independent brands

Thousands of unique pieces to shop

Second-hand treasures alongside products from independent small businesses

Local food vendors

Music and DJs at select events

Beauty, fashion and creative activations that vary from city to city

SHOPPING AT FTS

Every stall at Fashion Thrift Society is run by an individual business or independent stall-holder. Purchases are made and paid for directly at each stall, with no central FTS checkout.

Most stallholders accept card and/or cash, however payment methods vary between vendors, so we recommend having both available.

Bring along a reusable shopping bag or tote to carry your finds throughout the day. FTS tote bags will also be available to purchase at the merch desk at selected events.

BEAUTY, SERVICES & ACTIVATIONS

Alongside shopping, FTS events feature a rotating line-up of free and paid beauty, fashion and creative experiences.

Depending on the city, these may include nails, hair styling, barbering, tattoos, henna, permanent jewellery, piercings, tooth gems, grillz, tarot, brows and lashes, colour analysis, fashion illustration, records, kilo sales, clothes swaps and more.

Activations vary between events, with confirmed experiences announced via our social media and event updates.

Free services have limited availability and operate on a first-come, first-served basis, with sign-ups on the day. Paid services are operated independently, with pricing set by each provider.

TICKETS & SESSION TIMES

General Admission - $15

Entry is staggered across capped sessions and popular sessions may sell out, so we recommend booking your preferred entry time in advance.

Student Tickets - $12
Available to students aged 12+ with valid student ID.

Kids 12 & under - FREE
Free entry all day.

Companion Card holders - FREE
Free entry with a valid Companion Card.

Pension & Government Concession Card holders - $5
Valid card required.

Seniors 65+ - $5

FREE AFTERNOON ENTRY

2pm - 4pm 

The final two hours of the event are free to attend, however a free ticket must still be secured through Moshtix in advance to guarantee your spot. Free-session tickets are capped and subject to availability.

MORE INFO

Follow @fashionthriftsociety on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook for event announcements, confirmed activations, vendor previews and updates.

Visit fashionthriftsociety.com.au for more information, upcoming tour dates and everything FTS.

Celebrating your birthday on the day of the event? You can enter free all day - just purchase the free birthday ticket type and show valid ID at the door.

Please note: Photography and filming take place at FTS events and may be used by Fashion Thrift Society and its partners for promotional, social media and advertising purposes. If you do not wish to be photographed or filmed, please let an FTS team member know on arrival.
